notes: Social's interest Space covers, 2026-11-12. With Unsplash+ licensed for the welcome (DS9), the owner asked to improve the Social covers where an Unsplash+ photograph is clearly better, leaving the race covers as they are. Twenty-one candidates were drawn as directory cards and Space headers beside the current covers; the owner took five, and Triathlon & Multisport the same day as a sixth. Trail Running and Destination Races keep theirs. Each is the full source width cut to 24:13 around the faces, original colour, no retouching; four are 1200 px wide under 120 KB, and space-runners is 1000 px at about 152 KB, as its leaves only reach 120 KB at a quality that blotches (the 2026-11-10 audit kept seven dense covers over 120 KB for the same reason).
